note: Correlation of daily returns over 1 year and 3 years, across up to 500 stocks. The matrix shows the 60 largest; the pair list covers all of them.

cautions.not_cause: Correlation means two things share a driver, not that one moves the other.
cautions.unstable: It is not stable. Correlations rise in a sell-off, when everything falls together - which is exactly when diversification is supposed to help and does not.
cautions.survivorship: The universe is stocks listed today, so dead companies are absent.
